headline: Give every branch-to-advisor handoff governed context
capabilities: Automate customer intake, identity verification, and routing
Guide bankers through account opening, investment services, etc.
Provide real‑time risk assessments and financial research
Transfer case notes, risk data, and conversation history to advisors
outcomes: Ensured compliance through embedded policy guidance and validation checkpoints
Elevated the quality of financial guidance with risk insights and contextual financial research
why_try: A banker can ask who needs help, see the exact synthetic client and control status, and transfer review-ready context without making the customer repeat the story.

sample_prompts.label: Service intake and routing
sample_prompts.prompt: Who is waiting, what do they need, and where should I route them after identity checks?

sample_prompts.label: Client review
sample_prompts.prompt: Summarize the advisor book and show which client is already retired.

sample_prompts.label: Portfolio context
sample_prompts.prompt: Show the Whitfield allocation drift before our review meeting.

sample_prompts.label: Advisor-review considerations
sample_prompts.prompt: Prepare discussion candidates for Angela without giving advice or creating an order.

sample_prompts.label: Compliance checkpoints
sample_prompts.prompt: Which client requires senior-investor controls, and what other checkpoints apply?

sample_prompts.label: Banker-to-advisor handoff
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the Whitfield handoff with request, identity status, risk context, and compliance flags.
